work.composition: axial totem on dotted ground, dense base pile
work.description: Mixed-media collage layering compact discs, yellow tape strips, holographic foil fragments, and printed technical diagrams onto a perforated white ground. Centrally positioned, a hand-drawn aircraft outline incorporates iridescent CDs as landing gear and engine components, surrounded by target rings, red ink splashes, and photographic fragments at the lower register.
work.title: Float
